decisions.reason: The schlager compilation is a low-cost physical release that fits the firm's announced genre broadening, so management keeps it in the catalog even though it no longer appears in recent website records.

The illustrated series is a multi-model line with heavy design investment and a visible curatorial commitment, so management persists with it and attributes any weak sales to slow build-up and pandemic-era disruption.
Reissuing overlooked jazz on vinyl is core to the label's identity and benefits from the vinyl revival, so management keeps it on offer, possibly as a repress.
The box set represents a substantial production investment that management wants to justify by selling remaining stock, though limited editions can run out naturally.
The compilation CD received only minor visibility, but it sits in the warehouse at little cost and fits the broad-catalog strategy, so management has no strong reason to withdraw it.
